notes: Read both targets and full context. Resolve children, schools and federal education programs without expanding undefined statutory acronyms from outside the source. Preserve all-children financing access, God-given talent and motivation, and bulk rather than all Title I/IDEA funding. Omit the heading and do not import historical school-spending statistics from context.

claims.claim_text: Support for U.S. learning options including homeschooling, career and technical education, private or parochial schools, magnet and charter schools, online learning and early-college high schools.
Support for financing mechanisms that make educational choices available to all children, including education savings accounts, vouchers and tuition tax credits.
Enabling families to access learning environments that best help their children realize their potential is one of the greatest U.S. civil-rights challenges in 2016.
Support for educational success based on a student's God-given talent and motivation rather than address, ZIP code or economic status.
Support for most federal Title I funding for low-income children and IDEA funding for children with special needs to follow the child to whichever school the family considers best.
